panels.description: One line per base asset. Value = cross-venue spread % for that asset each minute: 100 × (highest close − lowest close) ÷ lowest close. Pick one or many assets, or All for every asset.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_ts AS ( SELECT MAX(metric_ts) AS anchor_ts FROM `${gold_dataset}.rpt_exchange_base_asset_price_comparison` WHERE ('${base_asset:csv}' = '$__all' OR base_asset IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${base_asset:csv}', ','))) AND ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) ) SELECT TIMESTAMP(r.metric_ts) AS time, r.base_asset AS metric, CAST(r.cross_exchange_spread_pct AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM `${gold_dataset}.rpt_exchange_base_asset_price_comparison` r CROSS JOIN latest_ts l WHERE r.price_rank_asc = 1 AND ('${base_asset:csv}' = '$__all' OR r.base_asset IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${base_asset:csv}', ','))) AND ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR r.exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND r.metric_ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(l.anchor_ts, INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND l.anchor_ts ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2 ASC

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_ts AS ( SELECT MAX(metric_ts) AS metric_ts FROM `${gold_dataset}.rpt_exchange_base_asset_price_comparison` WHERE ('${base_asset:csv}' = '$__all' OR base_asset IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${base_asset:csv}', ','))) AND ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) ) SELECT r.base_asset AS asset, FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', r.metric_ts) AS as_of_utc, r.cheapest_exchange AS best_ex, r.cheapest_symbol AS best_sym, CAST(r.cheapest_price_usd AS FLOAT64) AS best_px_usd, r.most_expensive_exchange AS worst_ex, r.most_expensive_symbol AS worst_sym, CAST(r.most_expensive_price_usd AS FLOAT64) AS worst_px_usd, CAST(r.cross_exchange_spread_usd AS FLOAT64) AS spread_usd, CAST(r.cross_exchange_spread_pct AS FLOAT64) AS spread_pct FROM `${gold_dataset}.rpt_exchange_base_asset_price_comparison` r JOIN latest_ts l ON r.metric_ts = l.metric_ts WHERE r.price_rank_asc = 1 AND ('${base_asset:csv}' = '$__all' OR r.base_asset IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${base_asset:csv}', ','))) AND ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR r.exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) ORDER BY r.base_asset ASC

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_ts AS ( SELECT MAX(metric_ts) AS anchor_ts FROM `${gold_dataset}.rpt_exchange_base_asset_price_comparison` WHERE ('${base_asset:csv}' = '$__all' OR base_asset IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${base_asset:csv}', ','))) AND ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) ) SELECT r.base_asset AS asset, FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', r.metric_ts) AS minute_utc, r.exchange AS ex, r.symbol AS sym, r.price_rank_asc AS rank, CAST(r.close_price_usd AS FLOAT64) AS px_usd, CAST(r.premium_vs_cheapest_pct AS FLOAT64) AS prem_pct, CAST(r.premium_vs_cheapest_usd AS FLOAT64) AS prem_usd, r.cheapest_exchange AS best_ex, r.most_expensive_exchange AS worst_ex FROM `${gold_dataset}.rpt_exchange_base_asset_price_comparison` r CROSS JOIN latest_ts l WHERE ('${base_asset:csv}' = '$__all' OR r.base_asset IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${base_asset:csv}', ','))) AND ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR r.exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND r.metric_ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(l.anchor_ts, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND l.anchor_ts ORDER BY r.base_asset ASC, r.metric_ts ASC, r.price_rank_asc ASC LIMIT 5000
